messages:
maria: FYI a customer hit write rejections after a proxy rotation — sticky cookie pointed at a pod that moved region.
ajay: saw similar in a canary when pods rescheduled across nodes. instance-region tag changed.
leila: fast-rotate (no-drain) seems unsafe when server-side residency checks exist.
samir: agreed. fast-rotate assumes session residency is implicit; we need an explicit session assertion.
maria: short mitigation: force-drain rotations for tenants with residency=STRICT. low blast.
ajay: medium-term: control-plane issues a signed short-lived residency lease (header or signed cookie). proxies validate locally.
leila: concerns: leaks (avoid PII), TTL choice, key rotation, and observability. legal needs region taxonomy.
samir: implement ed25519-signed blob, TTL 2-5m, proxies cache leases per-session, public-key pull with overlap.
sre-bot: canary: staging fast-rotate produced 0.2% residency-mismatch; rollback triggered.
maria: actions: RFC draft for "residency leases" (maria), proxy verifier spike (ajay), lease-issuer API + runbook (samir), compliance notes (leila). will open ops PR to force-drain STRICT tenants today.
